subject: Next steps: hosted fit scoping & endpoint cadence
content:
From: Elena Romero <elena@brightcart.com>

Cc: integrations@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — hosted feasibility questions

Thanks for the demo today — good overview. A few quick items from our side so we can decide Hosted vs Dedicated: 

- Traffic profile: initial pilot ~50 req/s peak (spiky during business hours), expected 1.5M tokens/day if we include search+generation.
- Latency target: 200–300ms p95 for short responses (<=128 tokens).
- Data residency: US only, standard contract ok but need audit logs.

Two asks: can you share the quickstart sandbox steps (endpoints + keys) and a sense for default rate limits on Hosted API? Also, is there a straightforward path to burst capacity if we exceed the trial slice?

Appreciate quick clarity so we can scope the internal procurement conversation.

—Elena
Sr Product Manager, BrightCart

---

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Elena Romero <elena@brightcart.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — hosted feasibility questions

Hi Elena — great to meet you and the BrightCart team today. Short answers up front, then next steps.

1) Sandbox quickstart: attaching the sandbox step-by-step (redwood-sandbox-instructions.pdf). It includes:
   - Sandbox endpoint URLs (staging + canary)
   - API key provisioning and rotation steps
   - How to map prompt templates to endpoints

2) Default rate limits on Hosted: for trials we normally allocate a sandbox slice of 20–100 req/s depending on profile. For your pilot (~50 req/s burst), we can provision a dedicated sandbox slice at 100 req/s to cover spikes. Token/day caps are configurable; we'll propose 2M token/day to start.

3) Burst capacity: yes — Hosted supports burst via short-term capacity bumps and automatic fallback to a lower-cost variant. If you need predictable higher throughput, Dedicated is the recommended path, but for pilot evaluation Hosted + burst policy usually covers it.

Proposed next steps (I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan):
- We provision a 100 req/s sandbox slice for BrightCart and send credentials (ETA: 48 hours).
- You run a 72-hour soak with your 50 req/s pattern and we collect latency/cost metrics.
- After soak, we review results and recommend Hosted tuning (batching/prefetch/KV cache) or Dedicated sizing if needed.

CC’ing Neha (ops) and Ben (acct exec) to confirm provisioning and SOW.

Thanks — Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
